claims.originating_goal: Route an already-admitted bounded StegSocials post-group use-state transition through the existing registered StegVerse Node and Universal InTr materialization path into the existing resident DEVICE_KV CAS receiver without creating another worker/runtime or granting Site transition authority.
expected_evidence: existing registered StegVerse Node status is required before routing
existing StegVerseGeneratedInTr intent and materialization request primitives are reused
existing HB-derived carrier is correlation only and grants no transition authority
existing MyKV DEVICE_KV service-worker URL and scope are reused rather than registering another worker runtime
Node outbox trigger is hash-bound to node/interlock/materialization request
resident worker validates the bounded-group materialization destination and request binding before CAS
resident worker delegates only local state persistence to the existing bounded-group DEVICE_KV CAS receiver
collision_boundaries: Do not create a second service worker runtime for bounded-group CAS
Do not create another DEVICE_KV database or object store
Do not create another InTr authority plane
Do not treat HB as execution or transition authority
Do not make Site publication authority
Do not accept or persist SKAP/social-provider credential material
Do not claim authentic current-iPhone execution from deterministic CI
claims.next_task_after_release: Exercise the merged route on the retained current-iPhone Node/DEVICE_KV, retain exact external InTr admission and pre/post-state readback evidence, then bind authentic StegBrowser publication/destruction evidence for a multi-post bounded-group test.
